question: The population of a city is 280,900 now. It has grown by 6% every year for the last 2 years. What was it 2 years ago?

question: In an examination, 15% of the students failed in Hindi, 20% failed in English and 8% failed in both. What percentage of the students passed in both subjects?
solution: Failed in at least one subject: 15% + 20% − 8% = 27% (those failing in both are counted twice). Passed in both: 100% − 27% = 73%.
